MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 16

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 49
   C. 31
   D. 41

3. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

4. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 17
   C. 31
   D. 27

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 169

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

8. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

9. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

10. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 22

12. Solve for x: x + 9 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 18

13. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

15. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

16. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

17. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 57

18. Solve for x: x + 6 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 6

19. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

20. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 3

21. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 36

22. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 2

23. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

24. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 12
